title: FoundingHostOfferDocument
description: One city's founding-host offer, at foundingHostOffers/{marketId} (a canonical market id from contracts/catalogs/markets.json). The first adminManageFoundingHostOffers replacement opens the offer; an organizer in the market that gains an owner while places are left and before the optional deadline takes the next place in a transaction that increments takenCount, so no two organizers take the same place. revision counts the owner's changes only; a place does not bump it. Never holds organizer or owner identities. Direct client access is denied; publicFoundingHostOffers carries the public count.
x-owner: adminManageFoundingHostOffers (cap and deadline) and the founding place grant (takenCount, lastPlaceAtMillis)

revision.description: Owner changes to cap or deadline; a taken place does not bump it.

cap.description: Founding places in the city. The owner decided 50 on 16 Nov 2026. Never below takenCount.

endsAtMillis.description: The offer closes at this instant; null means no deadline (the default).

trialDays.description: Free days a founding place grants, written into the organizer's commercial terms override (90).

takenCount.description: Places taken; each one has a foundingHostPlaces record with its place number.

openedAtMillis.description: When the offer was first opened. Organizers that gained an owner earlier are not founding hosts.
